extension.summary: Resonance: a minimal Spotify music browser and player for Kodi
Spotify-Premium-Musik in Kodi hören: Resonance-Plugin (Spotty/librespot), für ARM/LibreELEC auf Raspberry Pi
extension.description: Resonance is a lightweight Spotify music browser for Kodi focused on playlists, search, albums, artists and playback. Version 1 is built and tested for LibreELEC on Raspberry Pi ARM/AArch64, with experimental Android ARM binaries included. Windows, macOS and Linux x86/x64 are not supported in this release. Spotify Premium is required.

Resonance ist ein leichtgewichtiges Spotify-Musik-Add-on für Kodi mit Playlists, Suche, Alben, Künstlern und Wiedergabe. Version 1 ist für LibreELEC auf Raspberry Pi ARM/AArch64 gebaut und getestet; Android-ARM-Binärdateien sind experimentell enthalten. Spotify Premium ist erforderlich.

extension.news:
[B]1.2.1[/B] - Guided setup asks to finish setup when not fully signed in; rerun from Settings. - Each setup step reports its result in a dialog. - Reset Resonance in Settings > Account (keeps a backup). - Pairing during setup no longer starts playback. - Stalled Spotify Connect audio restarts the receiver. - Spotify Client ID kept safely across restarts. - Fixed busy spinner after setup sign-in.
[B]1.2.0[/B] - Finish setup/login navigation, fixing stuck busy spinner. - Fixed Spotify setup and Android playback authentication. - Added Spotify Connect audio (Android ARM64/ARMv7, Linux ARM64). - Use Kodi's streaming player to avoid live audio stuttering.
[B]1.1.0[/B] - Added Your Spotify Library, search, playlists, write actions. - Fixed artist/track context menus and playback status rows. - Removed local Kodi Favorites; one Reauthorize needed.
[B]1.0.x[/B] - Artist menus, playlist playback, browser-login refresh fix. - Version 1 release for LibreELEC/Raspberry Pi.
